words: Correction and rescope of D-a3hs. The defect said Nick had not declined the 2026-10-21 shaft recommendation; he later said, on 2026-10-24 while reviewing the coat, 'the tail color looks fine'. That is a sourced hold on the tail's color, so B-ajd4's darker shaft top is withdrawn and the shaft returns to its pass 5 colors. The defect stays open for coverage only: at 2x and 4x the shaft reads as a smooth, pale, bare tube (sig f11, f16, f29), which is a fur-coverage fault, not a color choice. Nick can override toward the sheet's darker shaft.
